policy:public.people.people_support_read.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (((((((support_access_sessions s
     JOIN platform_admins pa ON ((pa.id = s.platform_admin_id)))
     JOIN accounts admin ON ((admin.id = pa.account_id)))
     JOIN users admin_user ON ((admin_user.person_id = admin.person_id)))
     JOIN households h ON ((h.id = s.household_id)))
     JOIN household_memberships approval ON (((approval.id = s.approved_by_membership_id) AND (approval.household_id = s.household_id))))
     JOIN accounts approver ON (((approver.id = s.approved_by_account_id) AND (approver.person_id = approval.person_id))))
     JOIN users approver_user ON ((approver_user.person_id = approver.person_id)))
  WHERE ((admin.id = med_tracker.current_account_id()) AND (admin.status = 2) AND admin_user.active AND ((pa.status)::text = 'active'::text) AND (s.household_id = med_tracker.current_household_id()) AND ((h.status)::text = 'active'::text) AND ((h.lifecycle_state)::text = 'active'::text) AND (s.approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (s.ended_at IS NULL) AND (s.expired_at IS NULL) AND (s.expires_at > timezone('UTC'::text, clock_timestamp())) AND ((approval.role)::text = 'owner'::text) AND ((approval.status)::text = 'active'::text) AND (approval.revoked_at IS NULL) AND (approval.permissions_version = s.approved_permissions_version) AND (approver.status = 2) AND approver_user.active AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM account_lockouts l
          WHERE ((l.account_id = ANY (ARRAY[admin.id, approver.id])) AND (l.deadline > timezone('UTC'::text, clock_timestamp())))))) AND (((people.id = approver.person_id) AND (people.person_type = 0) AND people.has_capacity) OR ((s.activated_at IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM household_memberships subject
          WHERE ((subject.person_id = people.id) AND (subject.household_id = s.household_id) AND ((subject.status)::text = 'active'::text) AND (subject.revoked_at IS NULL)))))))))

function:public.identity_invitation_invi.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.identity_invitation_inviter(invitation_id bigint)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$SELECT inviter.id FROM public.household_invitations i JOIN public.household_memberships m ON m.id=i.invited_by_membership_id AND m.household_id=i.household_id JOIN public.accounts inviter ON inviter.person_id=m.person_id WHERE i.id=invitation_id AND i.email=(SELECT a.email FROM public.accounts a WHERE a.id=med_tracker.current_account_id() AND a.status=2)$function$

function:med_tracker.recovery_member_eli.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION med_tracker.recovery_member_eligible(p_membership_id bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts actor
    JOIN public.platform_admins administrator ON administrator.account_id = actor.id
    JOIN public.users actor_user ON actor_user.person_id = actor.person_id
    JOIN public.households household ON household.id = med_tracker.current_household_id()
    WHERE actor.id = med_tracker.current_account_id()
      AND actor.status = 2 AND actor_user.active AND administrator.status = 'active'
      AND household.status = 'active' AND household.lifecycle_state = 'active'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.account_lockouts lockout
        WHERE lockout.account_id = actor.id
          AND lockout.deadline > pg_catalog.timezone('UTC',pg_catalog.clock_timestamp())
      )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '42501', MESSAGE = 'Recovery eligibility unavailable';
  END IF;
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.household_memberships membership
    JOIN public.accounts account ON account.person_id = membership.person_id
    JOIN public.people person ON person.id = membership.person_id
    JOIN public.users actor_user ON actor_user.person_id = person.id
    WHERE membership.id = p_membership_id
      AND membership.household_id = med_tracker.current_household_id()
      AND membership.status = 'active' AND membership.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND account.status = 2 AND actor_user.active
      AND person.person_type = 0 AND person.has_capacity
  );
END;
$function$
